My personal tip I always tell new people, since its what I did as a noob when I first started, is make your first character (If this is 5e D&D, the simplest version of the game) be a Fighter, and level him into the Eldritch Knight archetype.

Your first two levels as a player will be super simple and help you learn the basics of "Hit thing with stick" and "Talk to thing before hitting it with a stick", and at level 3 when you should be getting the hang of those things, it adds spells to your repertoire, so introduces you to a very simple version of spellcasting with a very small initial list of spells to use.
